required_fixes: Frozen C2 (normalized PMI == 0.0 exactly) must be replaced with threshold check (|PMI| < 0.001 bits) or alpha=0 (no smoothing) for future hash-SPA PMI experiments. Current value 5.79e-05 bits (4 variants) and 8.71e-05 (vue) is mathematically forced Laplace alpha=1.0 artifact (see V1), not pipeline failure. Re-running with consistent no-smoothing gives normalized PMI = 0.0 exactly.

Frozen C5 (>=5 unique raw URLs per variant) is unachievable on TodoMVC (3-4 raw URLs: #/, #/active, #/completed plus trailing-slash variant). Next SPA PMI prereg must set threshold to >=3 unique raw URLs (TodoMVC-feasible) or switch testbed to richer SPA with >=5 route states. Historical comparison: parent EXP-PHYSICS-35209110569 handoff already disclosed 3-fragment structure; threshold misspecification is design error, not measurement invalidity.

Synthetic positive control spec mismatch: spec.json and prereg.md claim 4 actions but run_analysis.py:249 SYNTHETIC_ACTIONS has 3 actions (form_submit, button_click, js_navigate). Align spec and code (either 3 or 4) before reuse; outcome still passes (1.578 >=1.0) so no decision impact in this run.

PMI estimator smoothing is inconsistent (p_joint unsmoothed, marginals smoothed) inflating raw PMI by ~0.003 bits (nosmooth 0.1866 vs Laplace 0.1895). Future preregs should specify consistent smoothing or no smoothing and report both, to avoid biasing effect size and null control.

validity_findings.finding: Normalized PMI 5.79e-05 (4 variants) and 8.71e-05 (vue) is not evidence of state information. With 1 unique normalized state, distinct_next=1, p_s_next_given_s=1, and p_a_given_s=(count_sa+1)/(N+3), analytic weighted mean = sum(c/N * log2((c/N)/((c+1)/(N+3)))) = 5.79e-05 for N=93 (verified by independent recomputation). No-smoothing PMI is exactly 0.0. This validates producer validity_notes[0] artifact explanation and confirms normalized unique_states=1, url_entropy=0.0 on all 5 variants (raw_analysis_results.json).

Validation: 0/457 NL transitions have action_target == url_after (leakage), while 100% of vanillajs/react/svelte/vue link_clicks have target==after (37/37, 23/23), angular 23/37 (14 mismatched still excluded). validity_findings.finding: Cross-trajectory shuffle within sessions (7 sessions, 12-15 NL per session, seed=42, 1000 perms) yields valid null. Null mean 0.020-0.047 bits non-zero due to smoothing; observed 4-5x null. All 5 variants achieve minimum p=0.000999 (0 exceedances). Identical p across variants reflects deterministic protocol and identical session grouping, not bug. However history-length is not tested: sessions are independent trajectories; shuffling within session preserves session state but destroys action->next_state association. Low singleton SA fraction 0.0 and SA pairs 9-10 ensure estimator non-degeneracy (distinct triples 9-11).

C-WEB-DYNAMICS requires 'predictive dynamical structure beyond memory and ordinary similarity.' This experiment tests I(url_after; action | url_before) only, without history-conditioned baseline I(url_after; action | url_before, H_K) or memoryless control (EXP-PHYSICS-34724244876 paradigm). On deterministic TodoMVC transitions (e.g., vanillajs (url_before, action, url_after) counts show deterministic: (#/ , form_submit) -> #/ 12x etc), positive PMI could reflect memoryless Markov dynamics, not beyond-memory structure. Producer correctly discloses ceiling bounded and does not claim C-WEB-DYNAMICS validation (report.md: What This Does NOT Demonstrate). Max justified ceiling is fragment-aware URL-level Markov predictability, not beyond-memory dynamics.
validity_findings.evidence: report.md interpretation sections; python triple counts deterministic; spec.json hypothesis vs broader claim C-WEB-DYNAMICS; handoff analogy from EXP-PHYSICS-34724244876 K=3 history test

validity_findings.finding: compute_pmi_stats smooths p(a|s) and p(s'|s) with Laplace alpha=1.0 but leaves p(a,s'|s)=count_sasn/count_s unsmoothed. This biases PMI upward (mean +0.0029 bits on vanillajs) and guarantees normalized PMI >0. Analytic demonstration in V1. Unbiased estimator would smooth jointly or use alpha=0. Bias is small (1.5%) and does not cross 0.05 threshold (both smoothed and nosmooth >0.05), but inflates effect size and breaks exact-zero null expectation.
validity_findings.evidence: run_analysis.py:compute_pmi_stats lines 149-151; recomputed nosmooth 0.186595889 vs smoothed 0.189482; spec.json measurement_validity alpha=1.0 disclosure

claim_ceiling: Raw URL PMI with fragments preserved is significantly positive (0.188-0.209 bits, Bonferroni p=0.001, d=6.5-9.0) on 5/5 TodoMVC hash-SPA variants, demonstrating hash-fragment routing encodes Markov-predictive state information detectable by PMI when fragments are preserved; fragment-stripping normalization destroys this information (normalized PMI = 0.0 nosmooth, 5.8e-05 smoothed artifact, unique_states=1, entropy 0.0, difference 0.188-0.209 bits quantifies information loss). Positive control validates estimator (1.58 bits). Maximum justified: fragment-aware URL-level PMI detects state-conditioned predictability on minimal TodoMVC hash-SPAs at 85-93 NL transitions. NOT justified: (a) SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST per frozen 5-condition rule (fails C2 exact-zero and C5 >=5 URLs; threshold misspecification not pipeline failure), (b) C-WEB-DYNAMICS beyond-memory dynamics (no history-conditioned PMI tested; transitions largely deterministic Markov), (c) generalization to production SPAs with history routing/auth/richer state spaces, (d) title-aware or DOM-based PMI (titles constant entropy 0.0), (e) practical utility for SPIDER exploration (0.19 bits is 12% of max for 3-4 states).
